item.title: [Training Data] Parallel’s Parag Agrawal: Building a New Web for AI Agents
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:40 Our view at Parallel is that human click data is a bug, and agent doing work with search should rely on agent feedback, not human feedback. We believe that these models are really good at compressing information and we can benefit from a lot of the research that have gone into building models and apply it to search indexing and ranking. And so you can now make many, many arguments. And that's the arguments we made back then that actually now it's way more tractable as a...
